courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 束筒高層結構系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「斜交網格的軸力傳力與角度取捨」與「節點原型試驗與應力集中驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；束筒高層結構系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Axial load paths and the angle trade-off" and "Node prototype tests and stress-concentration checks" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bundled-tube tall-building systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以斜柱軸力同時抵抗重力與側力的斜交網格：斜角取捨、樓板環向繫材、節點、施工幾何與耐火維護；束筒高層結構系統則以把數個框架筒束在一起以減少剪力滯後、並讓筒體逐段截止的束筒系統，從鋼構威利斯大樓到混凝土六角束筒為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on diagrids that carry gravity and lateral load through diagonal axial force: angle trade-offs, floor hoop ties, nodes, erection geometry and fire upkeep; Bundled-tube tall-building systems centres on bundling framed tubes to cut shear lag and let tubes stop at different heights, from the steel Willis Tower to hexagonal concrete bundles, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「斜柱角度」與「框架筒剪力滯後」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到束筒高層結構系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「邊界層風洞試驗與束筒外形」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Diagonal angle” and “Shear lag in a framed tube”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bundled-tube tall-building systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Boundary-layer wind-tunnel testing of the bundled form", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築斜交網格結構
history.text: 以斜向構件組成網格的結構可追溯到 19 世紀末俄國工程師舒霍夫的雙曲面與網殼結構，而現代高層建築的斜交網格在 2000 年代成為重要的抗側系統：倫敦聖瑪莉艾克斯 30 號（2003 年完工、2004 年啟用）以 Arup 設計的全三角化周邊結構形成曲面外形，紐約赫斯特大樓（2006）以四層一組的斜交網格建在 1928 年歷史建築的立面之上，廣州國際金融中心（2010）則以鋼管混凝土斜柱把斜交網格推上 438.6 m 的超高層。斜交網格以軸力取代彎矩，節省鋼材並形成開放的室內空間，但也把複雜度集中在節點與施工幾何。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Structures built from grids of diagonal members trace back to the hyperboloid and lattice-shell works of the Russian engineer Vladimir Shukhov in the late nineteenth century, while modern high-rise diagrids became an important lateral system in the 2000s: 30 St Mary Axe in London (completed 2003, opened 2004) uses Arup's fully triangulated perimeter structure to form its curved shape, the Hearst Tower in New York (2006) raises a four-storey-module diagrid above the façade of a 1928 landmark, and the Guangzhou International Finance Center (2010) carries a diagrid of concrete-filled tubes to 438.6 m. Diagrids replace bending with axial force, saving steel and opening up interiors, but they concentrate complexity in the nodes and in erection geometry. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
